title: CCS LTC Batch 5: Types, blocks, carry-over, destinations and fresh recruits

cards.title: Home Town: once per two calendar years
cards.rule: Home Town LTC is available once in a block of two calendar years, subject to eligibility; it is not once every calendar year under the normal scheme.
cards.explanation_roman: Normal Home Town: two calendar years ke block mein one occasion.
cards.example_roman: Ravi ne 2026 mein li; same 2026–27 block mein repeat nahi.
cards.trap: Calendar blocks, not two years counted from the last trip.

cards.title: Distance is not a minimum-kilometre test
cards.spoken_ref_roman: Rule eight a; FAQs nineteen, seventy.
cards.rule: Home Town LTC is irrespective of distance, but headquarters and accepted Home Town must be different places. A short distance is not itself a bar.
cards.explanation_roman: Distance chhota ho sakta hai; HQ aur Home Town alag places hon.
cards.example_roman: Neha ka Home Town nearby hai; distance alone se reject nahi.
cards.trap: Same HQ and Home Town is not a zero-kilometre reimbursable journey.

cards.title: All India: once per four calendar years
cards.rule: Any Place in India LTC is available once in a four-calendar-year block, irrespective of distance, subject to the Home Town adjustment proviso where applicable.
cards.explanation_roman: All India: four calendar years mein one occasion, distance chahe jitna ho; India ke andar.
cards.example_roman: Ravi 2026 mein Goa gaya; 2028 ka second All India nahi.
cards.trap: No automatic annual All-India right; fare/class conditions still apply.

cards.ref: Rule 8(b), proviso: in lieu and adjustment
cards.title: All India replaces one Home Town occasion
cards.rule: Where Home Town LTC is available, All India is in lieu of and adjusted against the Home Town LTC available at commencement of the outward journey.
cards.explanation_roman: All India extra third occasion nahi; one Home Town ko replace karta hai.
cards.example_roman: Neha: 2026–27 All India li; usi slot ki extra Home Town nahi.
cards.trap: Do not add two Home Town plus a third All India.

cards.title: Two Home Town is also a valid normal choice
cards.spoken_ref_roman: Rule eight a and b, normal choice.
cards.rule: For normal HQ-different employees, two Home Town LTCs (one per two-year sub-block), OR one Home Town and one All India in the four-year block, are available. All India is not compulsory.
cards.explanation_roman: Two Home Town bhi allowed; All India lena compulsory nahi.
cards.example_roman: Ravi: 2026–27 aur 2028–29, dono mein Home Town choose karta hai.
cards.trap: FAQ Table 2 mixed options do not prohibit two Home Town LTCs.

cards.ref: Rule 8(b), proviso: available at outward commencement
cards.title: Do not borrow a future Home Town slot
cards.spoken_ref_roman: Rule eight b, proviso, journey date.
cards.rule: The relevant Home Town entitlement must be available when the All-India outward journey commences; exhausting the current entitlement does not permit borrowing the next sub-block in advance.
cards.explanation_roman: Outward date par Home Town slot available ho; future slot advance nahi.
cards.example_roman: Neha ne 2026–27 Home Town use ki; 2027 mein usi slot par All India nahi.
cards.trap: A new calendar year is not necessarily a new two-year sub-block.

cards.ref: Rule 8(c): family living away at Home Town
cards.title: Self-only annual option: qualifying situation
cards.spoken_ref_roman: Rule eight, clause c, family location.
cards.rule: An employee whose family is living away at the Home Town may elect self-only Home Town LTC every year in place of all other concessions under the scheme.
cards.explanation_roman: Family Home Town par away rehti hai? Self-only annual option dekho.
cards.example_roman: Delhi-posted Ravi ki family Jaipur mein; khud yearly visit option leta hai.
cards.trap: This is an election with a full trade-off, not an added entitlement.

cards.ref: Rule 8(c): in lieu of ALL concessions
cards.title: Annual self visits replace family and All India
cards.rule: The self-only annual Home Town election substitutes for all other employee/family LTC concessions, including Any Place in India; family trips cannot be stacked on it.
cards.explanation_roman: Self annual choose kiya, toh family LTC aur All India saath nahi.
cards.example_roman: Neha annual self Home Town leti hai; extra family Goa claim nahi.
cards.trap: Giving up only All India while keeping family Home Town would be wrong.

cards.ref: Rule 8(c) contrasted with Rule 10 and Rule 7 note 14
cards.title: Do not merge separate annual schemes
cards.spoken_ref_roman: Rule eight c; Rule ten, distinction.
cards.rule: Rule 8(c) is distinct from the special posted-staff package. Rule 10 ordinary two/four-year carry does not create a blanket carry-forward for this annual election; do not invent a career-irrevocable option.
cards.explanation_roman: Ye normal annual option hai, posted-staff package nahi; blanket annual grace nahi.
cards.example_roman: Ravi unused annual visit ko normal two-year carry bolkar add nahi karta.
cards.trap: Special posted-staff option and emergency passages were covered in Batch 4.

cards.ref: Rule 9: family groups and different times
cards.title: Family need not travel together
cards.rule: Employee and eligible family may travel in different groups at different times within the applicable block; the separation does not multiply their individual entitlement.
cards.explanation_roman: Employee aur family alag groups, alag time travel kar sakte hain.
cards.example_roman: Ravi March mein, wife June mein same available occasion use karti hai.
cards.trap: Different groups are not extra annual occasions for the same person.

cards.title: Outward date controls the charged block
cards.rule: The block is determined by commencement of the outward journey, even if the return is in the next block; booking, billing and return dates do not choose the block.
cards.explanation_roman: Block outward journey se count hota hai, return ya booking se nahi.
cards.example_roman: Neha 30 December 2025 nikli, January return; charge old block.
cards.trap: A later return does not automatically shift the trip to the new block.

cards.ref: Rule 9: separate outward dates, read with Rule 10
cards.title: Each group has its own outward date
cards.spoken_ref_roman: Rule nine, each group ki date.
cards.rule: Separate groups require their own outward dates and entitlement accounting. A January group may use an eligible old-block carry or current block, depending on valid sanction and ledger; not automatically current only.
cards.explanation_roman: Har group ki outward date dekho; January mein eligible old carry bhi possible.
cards.example_roman: Ravi December gaya; family January, office old carry ya current charge check kare.
cards.trap: The master example must not erase the Rule 10 grace route.

cards.title: Grace also follows outward commencement
cards.rule: The outward-commencement principle also applies to Rule 10 carry-over. Start the eligible outward journey within grace; return crossing year-end alone does not change its block.
cards.explanation_roman: Grace deadline outward start ki hai; return next year ho sakta hai.
cards.example_roman: Neha eligible carry par 31 December 2026 nikli, January return.
cards.trap: No indefinite return right; ordinary leave and claim deadlines still apply.

cards.ref: Rule 9; FAQ 7: mixed family Home Town / All India
cards.title: Family can make different permitted choices
cards.rule: Eligible family members may avail Home Town and Any Place in India in the same two-year block, within each traveller’s available adjusted entitlement. Separation does not replenish quota.
cards.explanation_roman: Same sub-block: kisi ka Home Town, kisi ka All India allowed, quota ke andar.
cards.example_roman: Ravi Home Town gaya; wife available adjusted slot par Goa jaati hai.
cards.trap: Do not award the same person Home Town plus an extra All India in one slot.

cards.title: All India destinations may differ
cards.rule: Within an All-India block, each eligible family member may visit a different place of choice; they need not visit the employee’s earlier destination in that block.
cards.explanation_roman: All India par sabko employee ki same jagah jaana zaroori nahi.
cards.example_roman: Ravi Goa gaya; wife apni available occasion par Kochi jaati hai.
cards.trap: Destination flexibility is not an extra occasion or waiver of fare ceilings.

cards.ref: Rule 11 read with Rule 6: declaration versus choice
cards.title: Choice does not remove destination formalities
cards.spoken_ref_roman: Rule eleven, read with Rule six.
cards.rule: Family destination freedom operates with the applicable destination declaration and change-sanction requirements; it does not replace them. See Batch 3 for the detailed Rule 6 procedure.
cards.explanation_roman: Different destination allowed, par declaration aur change approval skip nahi.
cards.example_roman: Neha Goa se Kochi change chahti hai; required approval leti hai.
cards.trap: Cross-reference only: Rule 6’s detailed procedure remains in Batch 3.

cards.ref: Rule 10: first year of succeeding block
cards.title: Ordinary carry: first year only
cards.rule: Unused normal block LTC may be availed during the first year of the succeeding block, not at any time in that next block. For 2024–25 Home Town, ordinary grace ends 31 December 2026.
cards.explanation_roman: Unused normal LTC: next block ka first year, poora next block nahi.
cards.example_roman: Ravi ki 2024–25 Home Town unused; outward by 31 December 2026.
cards.trap: No routine office-created second grace year; exceptional relaxation is separate.

cards.ref: Rule 10, proviso: where Home Town entitled
cards.title: All India carry needs unused second Home Town
cards.rule: Where Home Town entitled, old All India can be carried only if the Home Town entitlement for the second two-year sub-block is itself unused and carried into grace; it supplies the entitlement against which All India is adjusted.
cards.explanation_roman: Old All India carry: second sub-block Home Town bhi unused carry ho.
cards.example_roman: Neha ki 2024–25 Home Town unused; eligible old All India 2026 mein adjust.
cards.trap: Not a requirement to finish Home Town first before the old block ends.

cards.ref: Rule 10, proviso: second Home Town already used
cards.title: Used Home Town cannot support old All India
cards.rule: If the second two-year Home Town concession has already been availed, the old All-India concession cannot be carried by replacing that already-used entitlement.
cards.explanation_roman: Second Home Town already use ki? Us par old All India carry nahi.
cards.example_roman: Ravi 2024 mein Home Town gaya; 2026 mein old All India replace nahi.
cards.trap: A carry deadline alone does not establish entitlement.

cards.ref: Rule 10, proviso; FAQ 17: no Home Town entitlement
cards.title: Same-HQ case has no Home Town carry condition
cards.rule: The Home Town proviso applies where Home Town entitled. A normal employee whose HQ equals Home Town has only All India; unused All India may carry into the first year without a nonexistent Home Town prerequisite.
cards.explanation_roman: HQ equals Home Town: unused All India carry ko Home Town condition nahi.
cards.example_roman: Neha Jaipur HQ aur Home Town; unused 2022–25 All India, eligible 2026 carry.
cards.trap: Do not extend this normal-scheme carry to fresh-recruit annual slots.

cards.ref: Rule 10 with Rule 9: separate block charging
cards.title: Old carry and new entitlement stay distinct
cards.spoken_ref_roman: Rule ten with Rule nine, ledger.
cards.rule: A valid old-block carried concession and a new-block concession can both be used in the grace year, charged separately. Carry does not create a second new-block occasion.
cards.explanation_roman: Old carry aur new slot alag charge karo; dono ko new block mat likho.
cards.example_roman: Ravi 2026 mein old 2024–25 aur new 2026–27 Home Town alag use karta hai.
cards.trap: Document the block/sub-block and the traveller, not just “LTC 2026”.

cards.title: Automatic grace is not automatic sanction
cards.rule: The ordinary first-year extension is automatic; an ad hoc extension order is not needed for that window. It does not waive normal LTC/leave sanction, declarations or other prerequisites.
cards.explanation_roman: Grace automatically milti hai, lekin regular LTC aur leave approval lena hai.
cards.example_roman: Neha regular sanction leti hai; grace ke liye special order nahi chahiye.
cards.trap: The master’s “no application/sanction needed” is too broad.

cards.title: Update the FAQ’s 2025 “current” label
cards.rule: FAQ 13’s current block 2022–25 was correct on 1 July 2025. As of 27 October 2026 the normal block is 2026–29, with Home Town sub-blocks 2026–27 and 2028–29.
cards.explanation_roman: FAQ issue hua tab 2022–25 block tha. Aaj regular block 2026–29 hai.
cards.example_roman: Ravi October 2026 form mein current block 2026–29 likhta hai.
cards.trap: Fresh recruits have a personal calendar; do not impose this national start on them.

cards.title: Same HQ/Home Town: All India only
cards.rule: For HQ equal to Home Town, Table 1 gives only Any Place in India once in each block 2018–21, 2022–25, 2026–29. No separate Home Town LTC is admissible.
cards.explanation_roman: Table one: same HQ aur Home Town. Blocks 2018–21, 2022–25, 2026–29: each mein one All India only.
cards.example_roman: Neha ka HQ aur Home Town Jaipur hai; normal scheme mein separate Home Town LTC nahi.
cards.trap: Table 1 is the NORMAL scheme; fresh-recruit FAQ 70 is different.

cards.title: Mixed choice 1: Home Town, then All India
cards.spoken_ref_roman: FAQ fifteen; Table two, option one.
cards.rule: Table 2 option 1 for 2022–25: Home Town in 2022–23, All India in 2024–25. The same mixed structure can be applied to current sub-blocks if eligible.
cards.explanation_roman: Table two option one: 2022–23 mein Home Town; 2024–25 mein All India.
cards.example_roman: Ravi 2026–27 Home Town, 2028–29 adjusted All India leta hai.
cards.trap: Table 2 does not make All India compulsory or grant a third occasion.

cards.title: Mixed choice 2: All India, then Home Town
cards.spoken_ref_roman: FAQ fifteen; Table two, option two.
cards.rule: Table 2 option 2: All India in 2022–23, Home Town in 2024–25. All India can replace the available first-sub-block Home Town, leaving the later Home Town.
cards.explanation_roman: Table two option two: 2022–23 mein All India; 2024–25 mein Home Town.
cards.example_roman: Neha 2026–27 All India, 2028–29 Home Town choose karti hai.
cards.trap: Two Home Town LTCs remain an alternative under the normal rule.

cards.title: Two LTCs: historical 2022 illustration
cards.rule: In 2022, unused 2020–21 LTC plus current 2022–23 LTC could be availed, separately charged and subject to each entitlement and All-India proviso where relevant.
cards.explanation_roman: Case one, 2022 mein: old 2020–21 carry aur new 2022–23 LTC.
cards.example_roman: Ravi 2022 mein dono eligible Home Town trips alag blocks par charge karta hai.
cards.trap: Historical illustration, not an invitation to claim a lapsed 2020–21 trip now.

cards.title: Two LTCs: historical 2024 illustration
cards.rule: In 2024, unused 2022–23 LTC plus current 2024–25 LTC could be used with proper separate block accounting and ordinary entitlement checks.
cards.explanation_roman: Case two, 2024 mein: old 2022–23 carry aur new 2024–25 LTC.
cards.example_roman: Neha 2024 mein dono Home Town trips ke separate block records rakhti hai.
cards.trap: Two in a grace year is not a permanent two-trips-per-year rule.

cards.title: Two LTCs: applicable 2026 illustration
cards.rule: In 2026, unused 2024–25 LTC plus current 2026–27 LTC may be availed, with old carry outward commencement by 31 December 2026 and the All-India proviso where applicable.
cards.explanation_roman: 2026 example: old 2024–25 carry plus new 2026–27 slot.
cards.example_roman: Ravi old Home Town June, new Home Town October mein use karta hai.
cards.trap: Same traveller must have both valid entitlements; not two fresh current slots.

cards.ref: FAQ 17, case 1: HQ equals Home Town, 2022
cards.title: Two All India: historical 2022 illustration
cards.rule: For normal HQ-equal-Home-Town employees, 2022 could contain unused 2018–21 All India plus current 2022–25 All India, separately charged.
cards.explanation_roman: Same HQ case: 2022 mein old 2018–21 plus new 2022–25 All India.
cards.example_roman: Neha ne 2022 mein old aur new eligible All India alag use kiye.
cards.trap: No Home Town carry prerequisite exists for this normal same-HQ case.

cards.ref: FAQ 17, case 2: HQ equals Home Town, 2026
cards.title: Two All India: applicable 2026 illustration
cards.rule: For normal HQ-equal-Home-Town employees, 2026 can contain unused 2022–25 All India plus new 2026–29 All India; old carry must commence outward by 31 December 2026.
cards.explanation_roman: Same HQ: 2026 mein old 2022–25 aur new 2026–29 All India possible.
cards.example_roman: Ravi old carry June mein, new block Goa trip October mein leta hai.
cards.trap: Two separate block rights, not two All India LTCs charged to 2026–29.

cards.title: Grace does not shift the national calendar
cards.rule: The one-year grace for a four-year block or two-year sub-block does not postpone the start of the succeeding block/sub-block or turn 2026–29 into a five-year entitlement.
cards.explanation_roman: Grace old slot ke liye hai; new regular block calendar shift nahi hota.
cards.example_roman: Neha old carry 2026 mein leti hai; new block phir bhi 2026–29 hi.
cards.trap: No general second grace year is supplied by this FAQ.

cards.title: Other-State NCR towns are not Delhi HQ
cards.rule: Cities/towns outside Delhi in other NCR States are not treated as Delhi headquarters for this purpose; FAQ 20 permits Home Town concession. Accepted Home Town and genuine admissible journey must still be established.
cards.explanation_roman: Other-State NCR town ko Delhi HQ mat maano; accepted Home Town check karo.
cards.example_roman: Delhi HQ, accepted Home Town Meerut: Neha eligible Home Town claim check karti hai.
cards.trap: NCR residence/commuting alone is not a free LTC payment or new Home Town declaration.

cards.title: Expired extension is not a current benefit
cards.rule: The one-time extension for 2002–03 Home Town, linked to 2002–05 All India, through 30 June 2005 is historical and not operative now. Ordinary current grace remains Rule 10; exceptional Rule 18 relaxation is separate.
cards.explanation_roman: 2002–03 Home Town, linked 2002–05 All India: one-time extension 30 June 2005 tak thi; ab expired.
cards.example_roman: Ravi 2026 claim par old June 2005 concession apply nahi karta.
cards.trap: Audit-only exclusion, not a nonobsolete extra six-month extension.

cards.title: Fresh-recruit pattern: three, one, three, one
cards.rule: After the one-year regular-service gate, eight calendar-year occasions follow Home Town, Home Town, Home Town, All India, Home Town, Home Town, Home Town, All India; not eight unrestricted destinations.
cards.explanation_roman: First two personal four-year blocks: three Home Town, one All India; phir same repeat.
cards.example_roman: Neha ka first slot Home Town hai; first year Goa All India nahi.
cards.trap: Only the initial two personal four-occasion blocks, not every eight-year career cycle.

cards.title: Changing government jobs does not restart it
cards.rule: The two personal four-year blocks relate to initial joining Government, even if the employee later changes Government jobs. Qualifying technical resignation preserves the original clock, not a new eight-occasion cycle.
cards.explanation_roman: Government job change se initial joining clock reset nahi hoti.
cards.example_roman: Ravi technical resignation se new post join karta hai; fresh count restart nahi.
cards.trap: Technical-resignation eligibility and pre-application conditions were detailed in Batch 4.

cards.ref: FAQ 65 read with Rule 7(1): one-year gate
cards.title: Eligibility first, then calendar-year occasions
cards.spoken_ref_roman: FAQ sixty five; Rule seven one.
cards.rule: The concession is admissible after completion of one year of qualifying service; calendar occasions start from eligibility, not automatically on joining or on confirmation. See official tables for exact anniversary boundaries.
cards.explanation_roman: Joining day se LTC nahi; one year service complete hone par first slot.
cards.example_roman: Neha joined 1 January 2025; eligible 1 January 2026, joining year NIL.
cards.trap: Do not substitute probation completion for the service gate.

cards.title: Do not cut off at eighth joining anniversary
cards.spoken_ref_roman: FAQs sixty four, sixty five; official tables.
cards.rule: Read “first eight years” with the eight eligible calendar occasions after the service gate. Table 5 explicitly puts occasion eight in 2033 for joining 1 January 2025; do not truncate that table at 2032.
cards.explanation_roman: Joining clock aur eligible calendar slots alag; official eight slots follow karo.
cards.example_roman: Ravi joined January 2025; eighth All India 2033 hai, 2032 nahi.
cards.trap: Partial first eligible calendar year is still occasion one; unused years do not slide.

cards.ref: FAQ 66: opting for the normal LTC scheme
cards.title: Normal-scheme election: no same-block hybrid
cards.rule: A fresh recruit may choose the normal LTC scheme, but then cannot avail fresh-recruit LTCs in that four-year block. This is not stated as an automatic permanent career-long forfeiture; do not invent unrestricted switching.
cards.explanation_roman: Normal scheme choose ki, toh us four-year block mein fresh pattern nahi.
cards.example_roman: Neha normal option leti hai; same block mein extra fresh annual slot nahi.
cards.trap: Record the choice and verify later applicable election; do not promise a reset.

cards.title: Unused annual slot lapses, not postponed
cards.rule: A fresh-recruit annual occasion not used in its calendar year lapses; Rule 10 ordinary block carry is unavailable. Skipping a Home Town slot does not bring the fourth All India year forward.
cards.explanation_roman: Fresh annual slot unused? Year-end lapse; next year extra slot nahi.
cards.example_roman: Ravi 2026 Home Town skip karta hai; 2027 mein two slots nahi milte.
cards.trap: No one-year fresh-recruit grace and no pushing the whole pattern forward.

cards.title: Transition at start of second sub-block
cards.spoken_ref_roman: FAQ sixty eight a; Table four, used eighth.
cards.rule: When the post-fresh cycle begins at the first year of the regular second sub-block, the Table 4 case gets Home Town only if the eighth All India was used; the forgone exception is in explanation (ii).
cards.explanation_roman: Second sub-block start par transition, eighth All India used: Home Town only.
cards.example_roman: Neha eighth All India 2023 mein leti hai; 2024–25 mein Home Town.
cards.trap: Do not generalise this to deny the source’s unused-eighth exception.

cards.ref: Table 4 explanation (ii): eighth forgone / not availed
cards.title: Important exception: Home Town OR All India
cards.spoken_ref_roman: Table four, explanation two, forgone eighth.
cards.rule: If the eighth All-India LTC was forgone or not availed, Table 4 explanation (ii) gives a choice of Home Town OR Any Place in India in the following 2024–25 sub-block. This is a transition entitlement, not annual carry.
cards.explanation_roman: Eighth All India unused thi? Following sub-block mein Home Town ya All India choice.
cards.example_roman: Ravi 2023 eighth skip karta hai; 2024–25 mein All India choose kar sakta hai.
cards.trap: Do not award both, and do not label the choice a carried fresh annual slot.

cards.title: Transition in second year: that year NIL
cards.spoken_ref_roman: FAQ sixty eight b; Table three.
cards.rule: If the post-fresh cycle begins in the second year of the regular second sub-block, FAQ 68(b)/Table 3 gives NIL in that year: 2025 for the illustrated employee. The next regular block starts in 2026.
cards.explanation_roman: Second sub-block ke second year par transition: illustrated year NIL.
cards.example_roman: Neha ki eighth 2024; 2025 new regular LTC nahi, 2026 se normal.
cards.trap: Do not invent a new mid-sub-block entitlement or extrapolate Table 4’s special exception.

cards.title: Transition at a full regular-block boundary
cards.spoken_ref_roman: FAQ sixty eight c; Table five.
cards.rule: When the fresh cycle ends immediately before a regular block begins, normal entitlement applies from that new regular four-year block, illustrated by 2034–37 after the eighth occasion in 2033.
cards.explanation_roman: New full regular block start ho, toh usual normal entitlement se transition.
cards.example_roman: Ravi ki eighth 2033; 2034–37 mein normal block rights, rules unchanged hon toh.
cards.trap: No ninth fresh annual slot; future years remain subject to future amendments.

cards.title: First slot can be a single eligibility day
cards.spoken_ref_roman: FAQ sixty nine; Table four, explanation one.
cards.rule: A 31 December joiner becomes eligible on 31 December next year. The first calendar occasion ends that same day; if unused it lapses. Remaining seven occasions start from the next calendar year.
cards.explanation_roman: 31 December joiner: next year 31 December first slot ka only day.
cards.example_roman: Neha joined 2015 end; first outward slot 31 December 2016, warna lapse.
cards.trap: Not LTC on joining day. This does not itself require return before midnight.

cards.ref: FAQ 70: fresh recruit with HQ equal to Home Town
cards.title: Only fresh occasions four and eight are usable
cards.spoken_ref_roman: FAQ seventy, same HQ fresh recruit.
cards.rule: A fresh recruit whose HQ equals Home Town cannot use Home Town LTC and may use All India only on occasions four and eight. The other six slots cannot be converted into extra All India.
cards.explanation_roman: Fresh HQ equals Home Town: only fourth aur eighth All India slots usable.
cards.example_roman: Ravi ki first three Home Town slots unusable; first-year All India nahi.
cards.trap: Do not replace fresh restrictions with normal once-per-national-block entitlement.

cards.title: Table 3: 1 September 2016 joiner begins
cards.spoken_ref_roman: Table three, gate aur first three slots.
cards.rule: Joining 1 September 2016: NIL through 31 August 2017; first Home Town 1 September–31 December 2017; second Home Town in 2018; third Home Town in 2019.
cards.explanation_roman: Joined 1 September 2016; NIL through 31 August 2017. Home Town: 1 September to December 2017, phir 2018, 2019.
cards.example_roman: Neha joined September 2016; August 2017 journey abhi eligible nahi.
cards.trap: First eligible slot is only September–December, not a rolling twelve-month year.

cards.title: Table 3: complete the eight-slot sequence
cards.spoken_ref_roman: Table three, slots four to eight.
cards.rule: All India fourth in 2020; Home Town fifth 2021, sixth 2022, seventh 2023; All India eighth in 2024. Every listed full year runs 1 January–31 December.
cards.explanation_roman: Full years January to December: All India 2020; Home Town 2021, 2022, 2023; All India 2024.
cards.example_roman: Neha seventh slot 2023 mein Goa All India nahi choose karti.
cards.trap: Annual unused slots lapse rather than postponing the fixed later slot years.

cards.title: Table 3: NIL 2025, normal 2026–29
cards.spoken_ref_roman: Table three, final rows aur explanations.
cards.rule: 2025 is NIL, being the second year of sub-block 2024–25 within 2022–25. Normal entitlement follows for 1 January 2026–31 December 2029. Calculation is calendar-year-wise from completion of one year service.
cards.explanation_roman: Table three end: 2025 NIL; normal 2026–29. Calendar slots eligibility se.
cards.example_roman: Neha 2025 mein new regular trip book nahi karti; 2026 entitlement check karti hai.
cards.trap: Table 3 includes both the NIL-year explanation and eligibility-date explanation.

cards.ref: Table 4: joining, gate and first occasion
cards.title: Table 4: the one-day first slot
cards.spoken_ref_roman: Table four, gate aur first occasion.
cards.rule: Joining 31 December 2015: NIL 31 December 2015–30 December 2016; Home Town occasion one only on 31 December 2016. Explanation (i) places remaining seven occasions from 2017.
cards.explanation_roman: Joined 31 December 2015; NIL through 30 December 2016. First Home Town: only 31 December 2016.
cards.example_roman: Ravi first slot miss karta hai; 2017 mein expired first add nahi hoti.
cards.trap: Source never gives LTC on 31 December 2015 joining day.

cards.title: Table 4: every remaining fresh year
cards.spoken_ref_roman: Table four, slots two to eight.
cards.rule: Home Town second 2017, third 2018; All India fourth 2019; Home Town fifth 2020, sixth 2021, seventh 2022; All India eighth 2023. Each full year is 1 January–31 December.
cards.explanation_roman: Home Town 2017, 2018; All India 2019; Home Town 2020, 2021, 2022; All India 2023.
cards.example_roman: Ravi fourth All India 2019 mein use karta hai; third 2018 mein nahi.
cards.trap: Completion of the service anniversary does not redraw these calendar-year slots.

cards.ref: Table 4 final rows; explanation (ii) and source typo
cards.title: Table 4: transition and unused-eighth exception
cards.spoken_ref_roman: Table four, transition aur explanation two.
cards.rule: 1 January 2024–31 December 2025: Home Town if eighth All India used, otherwise Home Town OR All India per explanation (ii). Normal 2026–29 follows. Printed “2024–45” is corrected to 2024–25, not a new period.
cards.explanation_roman: 2024–25 Home Town; eighth forgone ho toh All India choice bhi. Normal 2026–29.
cards.example_roman: Ravi eighth skip karta hai; 2024–25 choice ko annual carry nahi bolta.
cards.trap: The omitted master footnote matters; Table 4 does not always mean Home Town only.

cards.title: Table 5: 1 January 2025 joiner begins
cards.spoken_ref_roman: Table five, gate aur first three slots.
cards.rule: Joining 1 January 2025: NIL through 31 December 2025; first Home Town 2026, second 2027, third 2028. Eligibility begins 1 January 2026; full slots run 1 January–31 December.
cards.explanation_roman: Table five: 2025 NIL; eligible 1 January 2026; Home Town 2026, 2027, 2028.
cards.example_roman: Neha joined January 2025; 2026 first Home Town available, other conditions ke saath.
cards.trap: Not All India just because national block 2026–29 has begun.

cards.title: Table 5: eighth occasion is 2033
cards.spoken_ref_roman: Table five, slots four to eight.
cards.rule: All India fourth 2029; Home Town fifth 2030, sixth 2031, seventh 2032; All India eighth 2033, each 1 January–31 December. These future illustration years assume unchanged rules.
cards.explanation_roman: All India 2029; Home Town 2030, 2031, 2032; All India 2033, rules unchanged hon toh.
cards.example_roman: Neha ke 2032 seventh slot ko eighth All India mat banao.
cards.trap: The official eighth date is not the eighth joining anniversary.

cards.ref: Table 5 final row and explanation; FAQ 68(c)
cards.title: Table 5: normal block 2034–37
cards.spoken_ref_roman: Table five, final row aur explanation.
cards.rule: Normal entitlement applies 1 January 2034–31 December 2037, because the new cycle meets the beginning of a full regular block. Apply usual normal rules, not another fresh eight-occasion cycle.
cards.explanation_roman: 2034–37 normal block hai; fresh pattern repeat nahi, future rules verify karo.
cards.example_roman: Neha 2034 normal Home Town ya adjusted All India rights check karti hai.
cards.trap: Forward illustration is not a guarantee that no rule can change by 2034.

D25.use: Government-hosted current corroboration. The 2026/04 upload folder is NOT the issue date or evidence of a 2026 amendment. Intro expressly permits two Home Town LTCs OR Home Town plus All India.

tables.title: HQ = Home Town: normal scheme
notes: FAQ 14/19: one All India per four-year block; no Home Town LTC. “Current” is as at 1 July 2025; 2026–29 is current on this review date.

tables.title: HQ different from Home Town: mixed choices for 2022–25
notes: FAQ 15 illustrates the mixed alternative. Two Home Town LTCs, one per sub-block, are ALSO permitted under Rule 8 / 2025 consolidation. All India replaces one Home Town; it is not a third occasion. Current analogues are 2026–27 and 2028–29.

tables.title: Joined 1 September 2016; eligible 1 September 2017
rows: Second year of sub-block 2024–25 in block 2022–25
notes: Explanation (i): after the fresh cycle, entry in second year of the second regular sub-block (2025 of 2024–25) gives NIL in 2025.
Explanation (ii): entitlement is calculated calendar-year-wise with effect from completion of one year of regular service.

tables.title: Joined 31 December 2015; eligible 31 December 2016
notes: Explanation (i): a 31 December joiner is eligible on 31 December next year; the first calendar occasion ends that day. Remaining seven occasions are available from the following year (2017 here). Unused first occasion lapses; not a same-day return requirement.

Explanation (ii): entry at the beginning of the second sub-block (2024 of 2024–25) gives Home Town if eighth All India used. If eighth LTC was forgone or not availed, choose either Any Place in India OR Home Town in the following sub-block 2024–25; not both and not carry of the expired annual slot.
Source transparency: the table prints “2024–45”; period endpoints and explanation establish 2024–25. Corrected here, not silently treated as a new rule.

tables.title: Joined 1 January 2025; eligible 1 January 2026
notes: Explanation: after the eighth occasion (2033), the new cycle starts with a regular four-year block in 2034; entitlement for 2034–37 follows normal LTC rules.
Future illustration under existing rules, not assurance against later amendments. Eight eligible calendar occasions are 2026–2033, not eight joining anniversaries ending 2032.
